profile_paragraphs: UA’s Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry was created on 15 April 2005. It comprises the Department of Medical Sciences and the Department of Dentistry; its current official page names Dr Joel Enrique Bravo Bown as dean.

Medicine originated in 1996. The current programme awards the Médico Cirujano title and Licenciatura en Medicina, and is listed as 14 semesters long. Its official programme contact is based in the Área Clínica at Av. Argentina 2000, Antofagasta.

For clinical teaching, Internal Medicine residents rotate at Hospital Regional de Antofagasta and at UA’s own Hospital Clínico. The HCUA reports receiving more than 11,529 students in rotations, placements and internships since 2021.

There is a concrete rheumatology-care link: HCUA’s telemedicine service added rheumatology consultations in 2024 and identified a rheumatologist. However, UA’s current medical-specialty list has Internal Medicine but no standalone Rheumatology specialty.

For an overseas academic, the university’s official international page expressly covers mobility, visiting professors and joint research. As of 3 September 2026, its official recruitment portal showed no open competitions, so there is no live vacancy route to assess for foreign-credential conditions.

unknowns: No official source located that identifies any Medicina course as taught in English; the correct status is unknown rather than inferred.
No current academic vacancy was open on 3 September 2026, so UA published no live recruitment requisitos on Ukrainian/foreign degrees, revalidación, nationality, visa or work authorisation.
The evidence supports rheumatology consultations within HCUA telemedicine, not a separately named Department or Unit of Rheumatology.
